detailed_descriptions.en: MONOMOON is a non-linear game focused on exploration and discovery. With no proper instructions, you must deduce and achieve your goals as you solve puzzles, find mysterious items, and uncover secrets hiding right under your nose. Features Explore a small open world "Metroidbrainia" that you can "complete" in about 10 hours, or dig deeper to find all that's hidden within. Layers of secrets, ranging from simple puzzles to cryptic mysteries and hidden game mechanics. The game doesn't end after the credits roll... A mix of platformer and point and click control schemes, utilizing both the keyboard and mouse. (Controllers are also supported but not recommended for the optimal experience) Player-driven exploration and progression: explore and discover things at your own pace. All puzzles and secrets can be solved by playing the game solo, and all clues exist within the game itself. However, we encourage discussing your playthrough with a friend to share knowledge and hints with one another.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
MONOMOON is a non-linear game focused on exploration and discovery.

With no proper instructions, you must deduce and achieve your goals as you solve puzzles, find mysterious items, and uncover secrets hiding right under your nose. 

Features

  • Explore a small open world "Metroidbrainia" that you can "complete" in about 10 hours, or dig deeper to find all that's hidden within.

  • Layers of secrets, ranging from simple puzzles to cryptic mysteries and hidden game mechanics. The game doesn't end after the credits roll...

  • A mix of platformer and point and click control schemes, utilizing both the keyboard and mouse. (Controllers are also supported but not recommended for the optimal experience)

  • Player-driven exploration and progression: explore and discover things at your own pace.

  • All puzzles and secrets can be solved by playing the game solo, and all clues exist within the game itself. However, we encourage discussing your playthrough with a friend to share knowledge and hints with one another.
